items.name: Friend of the Host's Ring
items.lore: The Host's ring: Lug's spear, small, in silver.

items.name: Host-Marcher's Belt
items.lore: A marching belt, with the Host's knot on the buckle.

items.name: Spear of Lug Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with a spearhead clasp. Only a Spear of Lug wears it.

items.name: Host-Seer's Bracer
items.lore: The seers' bracer, carved with what the trees whisper.

items.name: Mantle of the Lamfhota
items.lore: Green and gold. Only a Champion of the Lamfhota wears it.
